allies.rationale_text: First-principles-thinking strengthens creative-destruction by stripping away inherited assumptions before building the replacement logic.
allies.source_quote: stripping away assumptions to leave only a set of facts and a desired outcome
allies.affinity_rationale: Enabling mechanism — 'stripping away assumptions to leave only a set of facts and first principles' — first-principles thinking provides the intellectual foundation for creative destruction by removing the inherited assumptions that protect incumbent structures.
allies.activation_condition: When creative destruction requires stripping away the accumulated assumptions protecting an incumbent structure to reveal whether the underlying fundamentals still justify its existence

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps creative-destruction identify what in the current machine must actually be replaced rather than merely criticized.
allies.source_quote: understand how a system is currently structured and how a new one will function
allies.affinity_rationale: Structural analysis — 'understand how a system is currently structured and how a new structure could replace it' — provides the analytical framework for understanding what will be destroyed and what will emerge, but is a lens rather than the creative-destruction force itself.
allies.activation_condition: When understanding the systemic implications of creative destruction requires mapping how the current structure's components interact before designing the replacement

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias blocks creative-destruction when teams defend the incumbent logic instead of killing their own wrong ideas.
antagonists.source_quote: confirmation bias leads teams to process information to get the conclusion they want
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly blocks creative destruction — 'confirmation bias leads teams to process information to get the conclusion they want' — causes incumbents to selectively interpret evidence to protect existing structures against disruptive alternatives.
antagonists.activation_condition: When evidence of disruptive alternatives or incumbent structural weakness is being filtered to protect the existing structure because the team has a vested interest in its continuation

structured_tensions.tension_text: Creative-destruction conflicts with status-quo-bias when incumbent comfort delays necessary replacement of obsolete offerings.
structured_tensions.source_quote: creative-destruction vs status-quo-bias: incumbent comfort delays necessary replacement of obsolete offerings.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Creative-destruction conflicts with commitment-bias when public prior strategy blocks timely reinvention.
structured_tensions.source_quote: creative-destruction vs commitment-bias: public prior strategy blocks timely reinvention.
